shortDescription: This 24" Stainless Steel Tub Dishwasher offers show-stopping design and cleans baked on foods better with CleanBoost® technology. By avoiding hand washing and putting your dishes straight in the dishwasher you can save over 4,000 gallons of water per year while getting an effective clean.

features.text: Adaptive Quick Wash
The Adaptive Quick Wash Cycle adjusts cleaning performance and resources based on soil level for the cleanest and fastest quick wash in its class
Amplify your Clean with CleanBoost®
Remove tough baked-on foods and boost the cleaning power of any detergent with our patented CleanBoost® premix technology
Keep your Kitchen Quiet with 45 dBa
Keep your kitchen quiet and the noise inside your dishwasher where it belongs with extra, quality insulation.
Protecting Floors Against Leaks
In the event of a leak a sensor is triggered stopping the cycle and containing overflowed water in a tray at the bottom of the dishwasher
DishSense® Sensor Technology
Avoid pre-rinsing with our DishSense® sensor technology that automatically adjusts the cycle based on the soil level of your dishes
Target Spray Zones
Clean hard-to-reach spots with our Target Spray Zones that target tough spots for the ultimate clean
OrbitClean® Wash System
Featuring a rotating wash arm with multi-directional spray patterns to provide maximum coverage without using more water
Third-Level Rack
Save time loading and unloading with a third level rack that easily fits silverware, cooking utensils and tools
Smooth Glide Upper Racks
Dish racks so smooth they extend effortlessly to help making loading and unloading easier
Premium Capacitive Touch User Interface
Our sleek designed capacitive multi-touch user interface is intuitive and helps you to easily select the right program for your dishes
Adjustable Racks
Make loading the dishwasher easier with adjustable racks, providing enough space to fit even your largest items
Enhanced Drying with MaxBoost™ Dry
MaxBoost Dry™ technology uses heat and a fan to direct moisture out and pull in fresh air that dries your dishes.
National Science Foundation® Certified
Sanitize option removes 99.9% of common household bacteria
Convenient LED Floor Beam Indicators
Illuminate the floor with a blue light when your dishes are washing and a white light when they are clean
ENERGY STAR® Certified
Save money and maximize energy efficiency.
Smudge-Proof™ Stainless Steel
Resists fingerprints and cleans easily
